# wubble

> A calm, beautiful web browser for Linux and macOS: vertical tabs, Spaces and split view, free and open source (GPL-3.0), built on Chromium so sites work as they do in Chrome.

- Who it is for: people who liked Arc and want it on Linux or still developed; Zen users who want Chrome's engine; developers who let an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor) browse, each session approved, in its own Space, limited to allowed sites, local only and off by default.
- Has: vertical tabs, Spaces with separate logins, pinned tabs, folders, tab archive, sleeping tabs, split view (up to three pages), command bar, link peek, reader view, PDF, screenshots, picture-in-picture, video controls, built-in ad, tracker and cookie-banner blocking, encrypted password manager, import from Arc, Zen and Firefox, signed automatic updates, no telemetry.
- Does not have yet: extensions, sync, Windows, Netflix and other protected (DRM) video.
- Status: stable release 0.6.2 for Linux and macOS; used daily on both.
- Install: https://wubble.cc/#install
- Comparison with Arc, Zen, Chrome and Brave: https://wubble.cc/#compare
- Questions: https://wubble.cc/#faq
- Source: https://github.com/xuckless/wubble
